topic: Perspective-correct hyperbolic 1/w attribute interpolation vs screen-space affine texture swim rig
topic_zh: 透视正确双曲 (u/w)/(1/w) 属性插值对比屏幕空间仿射纹理游动扭曲
scope: Deterministic Heckbert & Moreton (1991) / Blinn (1992) projective (u/w)/(1/w) hyperbolic attribute interpolation versus naive screen-space affine interpolation across 17 screen stations spanning a 9:1 depth ratio. No neural view warping execution.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Precomputed vertex (1/w, u/w) linear interpolation with 1 scalar divide versus per-pixel 3D ray-plane intersection.

robustness.name: Sampled 17 screen-space stations preserve exact projective UV invariance across 9:1 depth foreshortening

good_fit: Custom WebGPU/compute-shader Visibility Buffer attribute decoders, software rasterizers, and deferred decal projectors
Explaining why 1/w and u/w are affine in screen space while raw u follows a hyperbola under perspective projection
Eliminating PS1-style diagonal texture kinking and swimming on perspective-tilted floors and walls
Precomputing vertex 1/z_i and u_i/z_i once per triangle so each pixel requires only 2 lerps and 1 scalar reciprocal
not_for: Purely orthographic 2D/CAD projections where w_clip === 1.0 is constant across all vertices (affine interpolation is already exact)
Flat screen-aligned 2D UI sprites at constant camera depth z_0 === z_1 === z_2
Neural novel-view synthesis or optical-flow warping networks
Non-projective spherical fisheye lenses where straight 3D lines do not project to straight 2D screen lines
